title: 第二千六百六十二章 蔚蓝水波的出海计划第二千六百六十一章 海外之地被玩家带偏的新年庆典
content_zh:
对于王者御魂争霸赛的赛程公布，主大陆原住民npc并不是一点警觉都没有，只是出于傲慢的心态，加上主大陆当前的局势，他们没有进一步的反应和动作。
此前想要出海却被拦阻下来的玩家在意识到这一点以后，果断选择即刻扬帆，省得夜长梦多。
为防止原住民npc的态度再次发生改变，横生不必要的波折，玩家们通过各种手段不断地加快航速，硬是赶在新年庆典结束以前，全数驶入主大陆的近海。
只是这时的玩家们并没有注意到，扬帆出海的并不单单只有他们，他们的后面还跟着一个又一个的小尾巴。
好在玩家们也不傻，在进入远海以后便相继【分兵】，最大限度地甩掉了这些小尾巴。
等玩家们发现这些小尾巴的存在时，玩家的船舰已经驶入外海海域。
为防止原住民npc顺藤摸瓜，掌握他们好不容易开辟出来的航道，这些玩家可谓八仙过海各显神通。
有的选择金蝉脱壳，让几名玩家乘着空船带偏后面的小尾巴；有的选择暗渡陈仓，先就近寻找岛屿建立假据点，再用幻影或空船壳做伪装，然后悄悄地离开。
另外，还有玩家直接在海上将他们的船拆卸成零件，然后用绳子相互捆绑零件，游到邻近的岛屿再将船只组装起来，从另一个方向离开。
总之，什么样的怪招都有，看得沐云又是一乐。
不过，玩家们虽然成功摆脱原住民npc的尾随，可主大陆近海至远海范围的海况，也被原住民npc所掌握。
好在，远海范围内的原住民npc势力跟主大陆的原住民npc势力并不是同一路的，他们在排斥玩家的同时，也排斥着主大陆原住民npc势力。
所以，主大陆原住民npc势力的船舰在确定跟踪无果后，除少数人留在一些偏远且无人烟的岛屿建立据点外，其他人都随船返航。
只是这些原住民npc没有想到，玩家们的胆子比他们想象中的还要大！
玩家们在发现这些小尾巴的存在以后，竟有不少人选择反其道而行，回过头来监视起了这些原住民npc的行踪。
当原住民npc的船舰返航以后，他们在主大陆远海的岛屿据点，也被玩家们一个一个地挖了出来，上传到玩家论坛上。
帝望规则赋予玩家们的地图功能，虽然会受到海上迷雾的影响，没有办法在航行的过程中显示自身的坐标，也看不到其它岛屿的位置。
可当玩家们进入岛屿周边海域的【无迷雾区】，地图功能便会再次发挥作用，不仅可以标定自身的坐标，就连自己去过的岛屿，也会在地图上显示出来。
玩家们只要把地图描绘出来，再将探索指针的指向标定注记上去，并以海外罗盘（用四方海域的永久指针制作出来的那种海域定位罗盘）作为参照，描绘出船舰航行的轨迹，即是所谓的海图。
为了防止自身探明的航线曝光，玩家们上传的岛屿坐标，都是利用地图功能绘制出来的那种海图。

重点在于，这种海图是可以直接载入地图系统的，玩家们只要得到这种海图，就可以在地图上直接显示。
只不过，相较于自身去过的岛屿，利用海图点亮的岛屿，虽然会在地图上显示，但明暗程度却有明显的差异就是了。
由于这些岛屿的位置被公布在玩家论坛，后续玩家在出海的时候都会主动避让，使主大陆原住民npc势力在大航海时代拉开序幕的前面几年，没能有效地把控玩家们的动向，为玩家们在前期争取到一定的发展时间。
等主大陆原住民npc势力反应过来并做好准备，正式进驻主大陆远海和外海，意图扼锁玩家们前往海外之地的航道之际，玩家们已经在海外之地边界站稳脚跟，甚至进入海外之地发展。
不过这是后话，在此暂且带过。
随着玩家们的探索，玩家论坛上出现越来越多有关于海外之地的情报，蔚蓝水波也终于想出一个确切可行的出海方案。
首先，他先整一艘小型潜水艇秘密出海，从近海范围找一座邻近远海且有少量原住民npc存在的岛屿登陆，然后在阵法和道具的遮掩下，进行他的造船计划。
届时，只要蔚蓝水波尽可能地避开主大陆原住民npc势力的眼线，在出海时别闹出太大的动静，以近海边缘岛屿作为跳板再次出海，被主大陆原住民npc势力发现的可能性极低。
蔚蓝水波在对照玩家们公布的海图以后，很快就相中了一座岛屿。
这座岛屿不大，也就几平方公里的面积，有百来位原住民npc长年生活在这座岛屿以捕鱼为生。
岛上虽然有淡水，但并不是很充沛，岛上的植物也以椰子树和棕榈树等热带性植物为主，整体的地势比较平，还有成片的湿地。
由于岛屿沿岸都是浅滩的关系，只有小型舟船可以靠岸登陆的关系，这座岛屿不怎么受到重视，基本上没有玩家和原住民npc势力对它感兴趣。
重点是，这座岛屿距离远海边界只有一百多公里，蔚蓝水波从这座岛屿出海，用不了多久就能驶入远海，利用海上迷雾来遮掩自身的行踪。
在确定出海的方案以后，蔚蓝水波便开始琢磨小型机关潜水艇的建造。
蔚蓝水波之所以打算建造小型机关潜水艇出海，一方面固然是为了遮掩行踪，最大限度地避开其他玩家和原住民npc势力的耳目，另一方面也是为了验证海上机关城的相关技术。
蔚蓝水波要是能用小型机关潜水艇成功抵达目标岛屿，他接下来所要建造的海上机关城，基本上就不会有太大的问题。
因为蔚蓝水波在机关潜水艇和海上机关城所使用的技术，很多都是通用的。
蔚蓝水波先在网络上查了查有关于潜水艇的相关资料，然后依照他的需求，简单地画了个草图。
然后，蔚蓝水波才取出海上机关城的设计蓝图，研究着怎么将海上机关城的机关移植到机关潜水艇上面。
结果这一研究，蔚蓝水波顿时意识到似乎哪里有些不对……
content_en:
Regarding the announcement of the schedule of the King of Souls Competition, the native NPCs of the main continent were not at all vigilant. It was just out of arrogance and the current situation on the main continent that they did not make any further reactions or actions.
Players who had previously wanted to go to sea but were blocked realized this and decisively chose to set sail immediately to avoid a long night and many dreams.
In order to prevent the attitude of the aboriginal NPCs from changing again and causing unnecessary setbacks, the players used various means to continuously speed up their sailing and sailed into the offshore waters of the main continent before the New Year celebration ended.
It's just that the players didn't notice at this time that they were not the only ones sailing out to sea, they were also followed by small tails one after another.
Fortunately, the players were not stupid. After entering the open sea, they [divided their troops] one after another to get rid of these little tails as much as possible.
By the time the players discovered the existence of these little tails, the player's ship had already sailed into the open sea.
In order to prevent the aboriginal NPCs from following the clues and mastering the waterway they finally opened up, these players are like the eight immortals crossing the sea to show their magical powers.
Some choose the golden cicada to escape from its shell and let several players take an empty ship to lead the little tail behind; some choose to cross Chencang secretly, first find a nearby island to establish a fake stronghold, then use phantoms or empty ship hulls as disguises, and then leave quietly.
In addition, some players disassemble their ships into parts directly at sea, then tie the parts to each other with ropes, swim to a neighboring island, assemble the ship again, and leave in the other direction.
In short, there are all kinds of strange tricks, which makes Mu Yun happy again.
However, although the players successfully got rid of the aboriginal NPCs, the sea conditions from the offshore to the far sea of ​​the main continent were also controlled by the aboriginal NPCs.
Fortunately, the aboriginal NPC forces in the distant sea are not on the same path as the aboriginal NPC forces on the main continent. While they exclude players, they also exclude the aboriginal NPC forces on the main continent.
Therefore, after the ships of the indigenous NPC forces on the main continent determined that the tracking was fruitless, except for a few people who stayed on some remote and uninhabited islands to establish strongholds, everyone else returned with the ships.
It's just that these aboriginal NPCs didn't expect that the players were more courageous than they imagined!
After the players discovered the existence of these little tails, many people chose to do the opposite and turned around to monitor the whereabouts of these aboriginal NPCs.
After the ships of the indigenous NPCs returned, their island strongholds in the far sea of ​​the main continent were dug out one by one by the players and uploaded to the player forum.
Although the map function given to players by the Emperor's Hope rules will be affected by the fog on the sea, there is no way to display their own coordinates during navigation, and they cannot see the locations of other islands.
But when players enter the [fog-free zone] in the sea surrounding the island, the map function will come into play again. Not only can they calibrate their own coordinates, but even the islands they have visited will be displayed on the map.
Players only need to draw the map, mark the direction of the exploration pointer, and use an overseas compass (a sea area positioning compass made with permanent pointers in the four sea areas) as a reference to draw the ship's navigation trajectory, which is the so-called sea chart.
In order to prevent their own proven routes from being exposed, the island coordinates uploaded by players are all charts drawn using the map function.
The point is that this kind of chart can be directly loaded into the map system. As long as players get this kind of chart, they can display it directly on the map.
However, compared to the islands that I have been to, the islands that are lit up using the sea chart will be displayed on the map, but there is a clear difference in the brightness and darkness.
Since the locations of these islands were announced on the player forum, subsequent players will focus on them when they go to sea.Movement and avoidance made the indigenous NPC forces in the main continent unable to effectively control the movements of players in the first few years before the Age of Discovery and bought a certain amount of development time for players in the early stage.
By the time the indigenous NPC forces on the main continent reacted and prepared, and officially entered the distant seas and outer seas of the main continent, with the intention of blocking the players' channels to overseas lands, the players had already established a foothold on the borders of overseas lands, and even entered overseas lands for development.
But this is a story for later, so I’ll mention it here for now.
As players explore, more and more information about overseas places appears on player forums, and Azure Water Waves finally comes up with a feasible plan to go overseas.
First, he built a small submarine and went to sea secretly, found an island near the open sea and landed on an island with a small number of indigenous NPCs, and then carried out his shipbuilding plan under the cover of formations and props.
By then, as long as the blue water wave avoids the eyes of the indigenous NPC forces on the main continent as much as possible, does not make too much noise when going to sea, and uses the offshore edge islands as a springboard to go to sea again, the possibility of being discovered by the indigenous NPC forces on the main continent is extremely low.
After comparing the charts published by the players, Azure Water Wave quickly spotted an island.
This island is not big, only a few square kilometers in area. There are hundreds of aboriginal NPCs who live on this island all year round and make a living by fishing.
Although there is fresh water on the island, it is not very abundant. The plants on the island are mainly tropical plants such as coconut trees and palm trees. The overall terrain is relatively flat, and there are patches of wetlands.
Because there are shoals along the coast of the island, and only small boats can land on the shore, this island does not receive much attention, and basically no players or indigenous NPC forces are interested in it.
The point is, this island is only more than a hundred kilometers away from the edge of the open sea. The blue water waves leave the island and sail into the open sea in a short time, using the sea fog to cover their whereabouts.
After deciding on the plan to go to sea, Azure Water Wave began to think about the construction of a small mechanical submarine.
The reason why Azure Water Wave plans to build a small machine submarine to go to sea is, on the one hand, to conceal its whereabouts and avoid the eyes and ears of other players and indigenous NPC forces as much as possible. On the other hand, it is also to verify the relevant technology of the sea machine city.
If Azure Water Wave can successfully reach the target island with a small machine submarine, the sea machine city he will build next will basically not have much of a problem.
Because many of the technologies used by Azure Water Wave in machine submarines and sea machine cities are universal.
Azure Water Wave first checked the relevant information about submarines on the Internet, and then simply drew a sketch according to his needs.
Then, Azure Shuibo took out the design blueprint of the maritime mechanism city and studied how to transplant the mechanisms of the maritime mechanism city to the mechanism submarine.
As a result of this research, Azure Water Wave suddenly realized that something seemed wrong...
